Accessibility Statement

KAALKRIT is designed to remain understandable and usable across keyboards, touch devices, smaller screens, and reduced-motion settings.

Last updated: 10 August 2026

Measures implemented

  • Semantic landmarks, headings, lists, labels, and a skip-to-content link.
  • Keyboard-operable navigation, controls, links, and visible focus indicators.
  • Colour and type choices designed for readable contrast on the warm canvas.
  • Responsive layouts tested against narrow mobile, tablet, and wide desktop compositions.
  • Reduced-motion support that presents the hero image in its stable final state and removes scroll-linked transformation.
  • Textual content remains available independently of editorial image treatments.

Reporting an issue

If a page or interaction is difficult to use, email teamkaalkrit@gmail.com with the route and what happened, or use the verified KAALKRIT Instagram account.

This statement is a practical description of the current implementation and should receive final human review before broad public launch.
